Title: Archaeology [Academic]
Name: Archaeology
Benefit: The Character may also use the Diagnose Skill on Constructs. Additionally, they may, once per Day, deliver by packet, the effects of a "Magic Break <Item>". Finally, the Character may use all applications of the Physician Skill on Constructs.

Title: Archaeology, Advanced [Academic]
Name: Archaeology, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may deliver a packet attack causing a "Physical Vanquish Construct" effect. Additionally, a Character with the Skill Smithing may use the Field Mend ability to restore five(5) Hit Points to the target Construct.

Title: Astrology [Academic]
Name: Astrology
Benefit: The Character gains knowledge of the stars and their movements allowing them a number of benefits. Firstly, the Character may act as a Secondary Caster for any Ritual Magic effect cast under the night sky. They may not be the Primary Caster unless they have Ritual Magic Skill. If the Character has the Ritual Magic Skill they count as an additional Caster when performing any Ritual Magic effect cast under the night sky. Finally, the Character may also discern more accurate information when using the Prophecy Ritual Magic effect.

Title: Astrology, Advanced [Academic]
Name: Astrology, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may perform a special divination ceremony taking at least five(5) minutes. Once they have completed this ceremony they may grant themselves the effects of a "Magic Mirage 5".

Title: Botany [Academic]
Name: Botany
Benefit: The Character may also use the Diagnose Skill on Plants. Additionally, they may, once per Day, grant themselves the effects of a "Physical Poison Shield". Finally, the Character may use all applications of the Physician Skill on Plants.

Title: Botany, Advanced [Academic]
Name: Botany, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may deliver a packet attack causing a "Physical Vanquish Plant" effect.

Title: Cosmology [Academic]
Name: Cosmology
Benefit: The Character may also use the Diagnose Skill on Elementals. Additionally, they may, once per Day, grant themselves the effects of a "Magic Elemental Shield". Finally, the Character may use all applications of the Physician Skill on Elementals.

Title: Cosmology, Advanced [Academic]
Name: Cosmology, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may deliver a packet attack causing a "Physical Vanquish Elemental" effect.

Title: Entomology [Academic]
Name: Entomology
Benefit: The Character may also use the Diagnose Skill on Insectoids. Additionally, they may, once per Day, grant themselves the effects of a "Poison Vorpal 5". Finally, the Character may use all applications of the Physician Skill on Insectoids.

Title: Entomology, Advanced [Academic]
Name: Entomology, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may deliver a packet attack causing a "Physical Vanquish Insectoid" effect.

Title: History [Academic]
Name: History
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may spend one(1) minute explaining to another, or muttering to themselves, some bit of historical trivia to grant the target, or themselves, the effects of a "Physical Curse Shield".

Title: History, Advanced [Academic]
Name: History, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may deliver a packet attack causing a "Magic Frailty" effect.

Title: Necrology [Academic]
Name: Necrology
Benefit: The Character may also use the Diagnose Skill on Undead. Additionally, they may, once per Day, grant themselves the effects of a "Physical Magic Shield". Finally, the Character may use all applications of the Physician Skill on Undead.

Title: Necrology, Advanced [Academic]
Name: Necrology, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may deliver a packet attack causing a "Physical Vanquish Undead" effect.

Title: Zoology [Academic]
Name: Zoology
Benefit: The Character may also use the Diagnose Skill on Animals and Hybrids. Additionally, they may, once per Day, grant themselves the effects of a "Physical Physical Shield". Finally, the Character may use all applications of the Physician Skill on Animals and Hybrids.

Title: Zoology, Advanced [Academic]
Name: Zoology, Advanced
Benefit: Once per Day, the Character may deliver a packet attack causing "20 Physical Body" or "20 Physical Healing".

Title: Apothecary [Merchant]
Name: Apothecary
Benefit: This Skill grants the Character the ability to Identify Potions and Poisons which are not in a living target. This ability takes sixty(60)-seconds to use on any number of targets the Character is holding. Additionally, if the Character has the Sense Poison Skill, they can also use this Skill to Identify Poisons present in living creatures.

Title: Appraiser [Merchant]
Name: Appraiser
Benefit: This Skill allows the Character to accurately determine the coin value of Trinkets. A Trinket is any Game Item which has a measurable value, usually of at least one(1) gold piece.

Title: Banker [Merchant]
Name: Banker
Benefit: This skill grants the character the ability to invest their money to gain interest. Any money the character has in the Bank gains one(1%) percent interest each month. Additionally, the Character may issue withdrawals or deposits to the Royal Bank during an Event.

Title: Chandler [Merchant]
Name: Chandler
Benefit:
This skill grants the character knowledge of candle making. Once per Day, they may perform a five(5) minute ceremony involving the creation of a number of candles equal to the number of candles for which they have Physical Representations. Once created, any Character may expend the created candle to deliver a single “Activate: Physical Lantern” effect. 
Additionally, once per year, the Character may create an exceptionally well made candle with a value of at least one-hundred(100) gold pieces. This item is Legendary and can be used in the creation of an eight(8) Ritual effect item. The Character must expend an amount of gold equal to the value of the item.

Title: Chef [Merchant]
Name: Chef
Benefit: Once per Event, a Character with this skill may prepare an exceptionally fortifying meal which grants all who consume it five(5) additional Hit Points until the end of the Day. Additionally, they may, once per Day, create a meal which grants all who consume it five(5) Fortification Points. Each additional Character with the Chef Sub-Skill increases the number of Hit Points, or Fortification Points by one(1). A Character can never gain more than ten(10) Hit Points from this ability.

Title: Fence [Merchant]
Name: Fence
Benefit: This skill grants the Character the ability to increase the amount of coin gained from selling items to the Merchant’s Guild by ten(10%) percent. This Skill cannot be used on any Player created Trinkets.

Title: Jeweller [Merchant]
Name: Jeweller
Benefit: This skill allows the Character to create Trinkets with a value of ten(10), or more, gold pieces. These items are Mastercrafted and are valid targets for Ritual effects. Additionally, once per year, the Character may create an exceptionally well made piece of jewellery with a value of at least onehundred(100) gold pieces. This item is Legendary and can be used in the creation of an eight(8) Ritual effect item. The Character must expend an amount of gold equal to the value of the item.

Title: Leatherworker [Merchant]
Name: Leatherworker
Benefit: This skill allows the Character to create leather Trinkets with a value of ten(10), or more, gold pieces. These items are Mastercrafted and are valid targets for Ritual effects. Additionally, once per year, the Character may create an exceptionally well made piece of leatherwork with a value of at least onehundred(100) gold pieces. This item is Legendary and can be used in the creation of an eight(8) Ritual effect item. The Character must expend an amount of gold equal to the value of the item.

Title: Locksmith [Merchant]
Name: Locksmith
Benefit:
The Character may, if they have a set of lockpicks, attempt to open any in-game lock. If no lock is present, the Character needs to role-play the process as a sixty(60)-count.
If the Character has the Open Lock Skill, they reduce the time needed to open a lock to ten(10) seconds. If the lock has a limited number of tries, they gain one(1) additional attempt.
Additionally, this skill allows the Character to create locking Trinkets, such as locks, sealed containers and chests, with a value of ten(10), or more, gold pieces. These items are Mastercrafted and are valid targets for Ritual effects. Additionally, once per year, the Character may create an exceptionally well made lock work with a value of at least one-hundred(100) gold pieces. This item is Legendary and can be used in the creation of an eight(8) Ritual effect item. The Character must expend an amount of gold equal to the value of the item.

Title: Tailor [Merchant]
Name: Tailor
Benefit: This skill allows the Character to create cloth Trinkets, such as clothing, with a value of ten(10), or more, gold pieces. These items are Mastercrafted and are valid targets for Ritual effects. Additionally, once per year, the Character may create an exceptionally well made piece of clothing with a value of at least one-hundred(100) gold pieces. This item is Legendary and can be used in the creation of an eight(8) Ritual effect item. The Character must expend an amount of gold equal to the value of the item.

Title: Textiles Artist [Merchant]
Name: Textiles Artist
Benefit: This skill allows the Character to create woven Trinkets, such as rugs, flags and tapestries, with a value of ten(10), or more, gold pieces. These items are Mastercrafted and are valid targets for Ritual effects. Additionally, once per year, the Character may create an exceptionally well made piece of textile artistry with a value of at least onehundred(100) gold pieces. This item is Legendary and can be used in the creation of an eight(8) Ritual effect item. The Character must expend an amount of gold equal to the value of the item.

Title: Tinkerer [Merchant]
Name: Tinkerer
Benefit:
This skill grants the character knowledge of proper journeyman repair techniques. Characters with this skill may Repair Broken objects made of Steel at a forge, as per the Smithing skill. If a character possesses this skill and Field Mend in the Smithing skill, then they can repair two(2) Mastercraft items instead of one(1).
Additionally, if the Character possesses the Skill Field Repair, they may use its ability twice before needing to Rest.
